name: Leena Rao
summary: Python engineer building assistants that coordinate approved actions across business systems. Four years of experience with service integrations and recoverable task execution.

work_experience.title: Intelligent Workflow Engineer
responsibilities_and_achievements: Built a service desk assistant that chooses from a limited set of actions, collects missing details, and prepares account-change requests.
Required staff approval before an external change and checked proposed action arguments against the receiving service's accepted fields.
Saved progress after each completed action so interrupted requests could continue safely.
Added a maximum action count and a clear handoff when the assistant repeatedly failed to make progress.
Checked completed outcomes using simulated service responses, including unavailable systems and rejected requests.

work_experience.title: Integration Developer
responsibilities_and_achievements: Connected billing and ticketing services and prevented repeated delivery from creating duplicate records.
Diagnosed failed requests using event histories shared with the support team.

projects.name: Meeting follow-through assistant
projects.description: Turns meeting notes into proposed tasks, asks the owner to approve them, and records the resulting task identifiers. Tested interruption immediately before and after creation to catch repeated actions.
